description: Add exec server template and edit capability for MCP servers in the Manage Tools modal

userStories.title: Add exec server template to MCP_TEMPLATES
userStories.description: As a user setting up a local execution MCP server, I want an Exec Server template in the Template dropdown so that I can quickly configure a stdio-based server without manually switching transport.
acceptanceCriteria: Add new 'exec' entry to MCP_TEMPLATES in frontend/src/components/modals/ToolSelectionModal/McpServerPanel.tsx with name 'Exec Server', transport 'stdio', url '', headers {}
Selecting 'Exec Server' from the Template dropdown sets transport to 'stdio'
The template appears in the dropdown alongside Custom, Ruska MCP, and GitHub MCP
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)

userStories.title: Add edit button to MCP server cards
userStories.description: As a user who has already configured an MCP server, I want an edit button on the server card so that I can modify the server's URL, transport, or headers without deleting and re-creating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Import Pencil icon from lucide-react in McpServerPanel.tsx
Add editingServer state: const [editingServer, setEditingServer] = useState<string | null>(null)
Each server card shows a Pencil icon button alongside the existing Trash2 delete button
Clicking the pencil icon opens the add form pre-populated with the server's current config (name, transport, url, first header key/value)
The form submit button text changes from 'Add Server' to 'Save' when editingServer is not null
Saving an edited server calls onAddServer(name, updatedConfig) which overwrites the existing entry in the Record
After saving, editingServer is cleared and the form resets and closes
Clicking Cancel while editing clears editingServer and resets the form
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)
